links.comparator_used: High-risk control patients on non-enrollment days receiving standard (non-expedited) screening-to-diagnostic workflow
links.outcome: Time to screening results, diagnostic evaluation, and biopsy among patients with screen-detected cancers
links.effect: Reductions of 99.1% (screening results), 99.1% (diagnostic evaluation), and 87.2% (biopsy); 94% of expedited patients received immediate reads and 26 received same-day diagnostic evaluation; cancer detection rate 60/1000 in expedited cohort vs 2.3/1000 in non-high-risk participants
links.quote: Time to screening results, diagnostic evaluation, and biopsy were significantly shorter in expedited patients versus control patients with screen-detected cancers, with reductions of 99.1%, 99.1%, and 87.2%, respectively.

design_hint: AI-based risk triage for same-day expedited clinical evaluation
